structured_output.summary: Fixed the rejected denied-cast feedback bug in PlayerManaUI.cs: the flash now targets the fill Image's parent frame/background Image (present in the committed scene as an always-rendered Sliced-type Image) when one exists, instead of tinting the Filled-type fill Image whose rendered area is zero when CurrentMana == 0. Falls back to flashing the fill Image itself if no parent Image is found (preserving behavior for hierarchy-less test setups). fillAmount logic and normal-color revert behavior are unchanged. PlayerMana.cs required no changes; ResetMana and CastDenied already satisfy AC-001/AC-002/AC-003.
